units.source_text: 我重拾对于K的良知，是在我打开大门，走进客厅时，也就是像往常那样穿过他的房间的那个瞬间。

en.t: My conscience toward K returned when I opened the front gate and went into the sitting room, at the very moment when I passed through his room as usual.

units.source_text: 他一如既往地正在伏案看书，一如既往地抬起头来望着我。

en.t: As always, he was bent over his desk reading, and as always, he raised his head and looked at me.

units.source_text: 但是，他并没像平时那样说：‘回来啦？’却问了句：‘病好了？看过医生了？’

en.t: But instead of saying, as he usually did, 'You are back?' he asked, 'Are you better? Did you see a doctor?'

units.source_text: 那一瞬间，我真想跪在他面前，求他饶恕自己。

en.t: At that instant, I truly wanted to kneel before him and beg him to forgive me.

units.source_text: 而且，我当时的那股冲动，绝不是出于软弱。

en.t: Moreover, the impulse I felt then did not come from weakness at all.

units.source_text: 我想，倘若只有K和我两个人站在旷野里的话，我一定会遵从良心的命令，向他谢罪的。

en.t: I think that if K and I alone had been standing in an open field, I would certainly have obeyed the command of my conscience and apologized to him.

units.source_text: 可是隔壁房间里有人，我的那股冲动便被压制住了。

en.t: But there were people in the next room, and that impulse of mine was suppressed.

units.source_text: 并且很可悲的是，再也没有能够恢复。

en.t: And, sadly, it was never able to return again.

units.source_text: 吃饭的时候，K和我又见面了。

en.t: At mealtime, K and I met again.

units.source_text: 还蒙在鼓里的K一直沉默着，并没有对我表露出丝毫怀疑。

en.t: K, still completely unaware of what had happened, remained silent and showed me not the slightest suspicion.

units.source_text: 不知内情的夫人显得比平时高兴，只有我知道所有的一切。

en.t: The lady, knowing nothing of the situation, seemed happier than usual; only I knew everything.

units.source_text: 这顿饭我实在是难以下咽。

en.t: That meal was truly hard for me to swallow.

units.source_text: 那天晚饭，小姐没有像往常那样，跟我们同桌吃饭。

en.t: At dinner that evening, the young lady did not eat at the same table with us as she usually did.

units.source_text: 夫人叫她来吃饭，小姐只是在隔壁答应‘马上就来’。

en.t: When the lady called her to come eat, the young lady only answered from the next room, 'I will be right there.'

units.source_text: K在旁边听着，感觉很纳闷，终于忍不住问夫人是怎么回事。

en.t: K listened from beside us, evidently puzzled, and at last could not help asking the lady what was going on.

units.source_text: 夫人回答说：‘大概是有点害羞吧。’说着瞅了我一眼。

en.t: The lady answered, 'She is probably a little embarrassed,' and as she said it, she glanced at me.

units.source_text: K仍是不解，追问道：‘为什么害羞啊？’夫人微笑着又瞧了我一眼。

en.t: Still not understanding, K pressed her, 'Why is she embarrassed?' The lady smiled and looked at me again.
